author: Sabine Hossenfelder
description:
Upgrade Your Shaving Experience With Henson (100 Free Blades): https://hensonshaving.com/sabine

Nearly everything published about quantum physics in the brain is nonsense. This time a physicist in Istanbul has come up with something different, and the key move is that quantum effects don't need to last long to leave a permanent mark. No exotic new physics required, and there's a concrete way to test it. Let's take a look.

Paper: https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2604.04069
